name: Fish and Finfish
description: Allergy or dietary exclusion of finfish and small dried fish products.
rules: Strictly excludes fresh and dried finfish (sea fish, sprats).
Excludes sprat powder and dishes containing sprat powder (e.g. DISH_FHB_SPRAT_RICE).
Does NOT automatically exclude shellfish (kunisso); finfish and shellfish restrictions are modeled separately.
Excludes alternative substitutions containing fish or sprats.

name: Crustaceans and Shellfish
description: Allergy or dietary exclusion of crustaceans, prawns, and shellfish products.
rules: Strictly excludes dried small prawns (kunisso) and other crustacean products.
Does NOT exclude finfish (sea fish, sprats); finfish and shellfish restrictions are modeled separately.
Excludes dishes and substitutions containing kunisso (e.g. DISH_FAMILY_MEAL_RICE_KUNISSO_DHAL).

name: Cow and Buffalo Dairy Products
description: Cow's milk protein allergy, lactose intolerance, or dairy dietary restrictions.
rules: Strictly excludes dairy butter, curd, yoghurt, and cheese.
Margarine is included under dairy restrictions because commercial margarine frequently contains milk solids, whey, or dairy derivatives.
Excludes dishes tempered with butter or snacks containing curd, yoghurt, cheese, or commercial margarine.
Does NOT exclude pure vegetable oils (ING_VEG_OIL) or coconut milk (ING_COCONUT_MILK).

name: Eggs (All Forms)
description: Allergy or dietary exclusion of chicken eggs in all culinary forms.
rules: Strictly excludes hard-boiled egg yolk, egg white, and whole egg.
Excludes composite dishes and snacks containing egg (e.g. DISH_HALFMASHED_GOTUKOLA_EGGYOLK, SNACK_EGG_HOPPER, SNACK_BOILED_EGG_WEDGE).
Excludes egg items from substitution suggestions.

name: Soya Beans and Products
description: Allergy or dietary exclusion of soya beans, soya flour, and soya products.
rules: Strictly excludes germinated soya beans, soya flour, and soya meat curries.
Excludes dishes containing soya (e.g. DISH_COARSE_MASH_7M_SOYA_EGG).
Does NOT exclude non-soya legumes (dhal, green gram, cowpea, chickpeas) unless RESTRICT_LEGUMES is also active.

name: Pulses and Legumes
description: Allergy, favism, or dietary exclusion of pulses and legumes.
rules: Strictly excludes red lentils (dhal), green gram (mung), cowpea, and chickpeas.
Excludes dhal purees, pulse mashes, boiled pulse snacks (SNACK_GREEN_GRAM_COCONUT, SNACK_CHICKPEAS_COCONUT, SNACK_COWPEA_COCONUT).
Excludes pulses from substitution suggestions.

name: Peanuts
rules: Strictly excludes peanuts, crushed peanut powders, and peanut pastes.
Excludes snacks containing peanut (SNACK_CRUSHED_PEANUT_PASTE).
Does NOT exclude tree nuts (cashew) unless RESTRICT_TREE_NUT is also selected.

name: Tree Nuts (Cashew)
rules: Strictly excludes cashew nuts, cashew curries, and crushed cashew pastes.
Does NOT exclude peanuts unless RESTRICT_PEANUT is also selected.

name: Coconut Products
description: Allergy or dietary exclusion of coconut milk, coconut oil, and scraped coconut.
rules: Strictly excludes thick coconut milk (miti kiri), fresh scraped coconut, and pure coconut oil (ING_COCONUT_OIL).
Does NOT exclude non-coconut vegetable oils (ING_VEG_OIL).
Excludes curries cooked in coconut milk, coconut oil tempering, and snacks topped with scraped coconut.
